mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 72 degrees with overcast skies at Fireman's Park. We are under a full moon, and although the ISS passes overhead tonight, we will not be able to see it due to the clouds.

In city news, Highway M near the new Aldi site will face closures from October 5 through October 7 for final paving work, with traffic detoured to Old PB, East Verona Avenue, and South Main Street. This follows earlier utility and shoulder work completed throughout the month.
We have a busy schedule of local happenings, including live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company today, followed by yoga at Insight Wellness tomorrow.
Looking at the police report, on September 5, a 26-year-old driver was arrested on Highway 18/151 for speeding and O W I, after testing over the allowed limit.
It is a great day to visit Culver's for the Turtle flavor of the day. The store is currently open and serving until 10:00 PM, so stop by for a treat before they close for the night.
